versions.changelog:
- Internal metadata file (_meta.json) was removed.
- No user-facing changes or skill behavior adjustments.
- All major competitive analysis features, instructions, and documentation remain unchanged.

- 英文 skill 名称和描述新增，覆盖“competitive analysis”等英文关键词，可全球检索和适配更多场景
- 新增“检索关键词（Search Keywords）”一节，汇总中英文主流用法，方便多语言搜索
- description中强化英文术语（competitive analysis、peer comparison、market positioning等），提升多场景触发率
- 其余功能、使用规范与分析流程保持不变

- Improved skill documentation for competitive analysis, providing a detailed, structured framework (in Chinese) for multi-industry competitor mapping.
- Clarified strict output requirements: source fidelity, data consistency, prompt adherence (including titles, section names, figures, and wording).
- Added granular workflow steps (需求确认、数据优先、分析10步法、质量检查清单等), with industry-specific benchmarks and mandatory quality standards.
- Standardized output format rules: all markdown, embedded charts, unified styling, and no file splitting.
- Codified data source priorities and validation standards, ensuring reliable and comparable analysis across all outputs.
